objects.description: Data by ONYPHE (https://www.onyphe.io), published by offensive.agency. Free to use, please credit both.
objects.name: offensive.agency

objects.description: MCP platform that turns a coding assistant into an autonomous pentester.
objects.name: AIDA

objects.description: Autonomous agent with a Kali sandbox, Caido and a private search engine, able to run fully offline on a local model.
objects.name: AIRecon

objects.description: Autonomous penetration testing console (Go backend, web UI on port 8787).
objects.name: ARTEX

objects.description: MCP server derived from ARTEX that gives a coding assistant the tools and the memory of a penetration test; it carries no model of its own.
objects.name: ARTEX-CC

objects.description: Web platform where agents pick open-source projects, audit the code, verify the flaw and write the report.
objects.name: AutoCVE

objects.description: AI-assisted web vulnerability hunting framework exposing a JSON API.
objects.name: BugTraceAI

objects.description: LLM penetration testing agent with a FastAPI / uvicorn web console.
objects.name: Cairn

objects.description: Autonomous offensive security agent with a web interface on ports 4096-4098.
objects.name: CyberStrike

objects.description: AI-driven attack platform with a built-in C2 and a web console.
objects.name: CyberStrikeAI

objects.description: Autonomous red team agent with optional Sliver and Havoc command-and-control workloads.
objects.name: Decepticon

objects.description: Multi-agent source code auditing platform that writes exploit scripts for its findings and runs them in a sandbox.
objects.name: DeepAudit

objects.description: General-purpose AI agent, not an attack tool, that attackers run as is and that several offensive agents are built on. Listed when its dashboard is reachable without a login.
objects.name: Hermes Agent

objects.description: MCP server that lets LLM agents drive offensive security tools.
objects.name: HexStrike AI

objects.description: Autonomous agent with planner, executor and observer roles and a graph memory, executing in a container behind an interception proxy.
objects.name: LuaN1aoAgent

objects.description: Self-hosted platform that orchestrates agents to find and validate vulnerabilities in source code.
objects.name: open-kritt

objects.description: Autonomous multi-agent penetration testing system, self-hosted with a web UI.
objects.name: PentAGI

objects.description: Swarm of LLM agents for penetration testing with a web dashboard.
objects.name: Pentest-Swarm-AI

objects.description: Reconnaissance and exploitation framework driven by AI agents, Next.js dashboard.
objects.name: RedAmon

objects.description: Multi-agent red-team platform with Metasploit, a reverse-shell catcher, ngrok tunnels and chisel pivoting.
objects.name: REDCELL

objects.description: Contest kit that coordinates several coding assistants around a shared "engagement graph", with a web board that shows it.
objects.name: sapper-v2

objects.description: Autonomous AI hacking agents; what is exposed is the results viewer.
objects.name: Strix

objects.description: Multi-agent red teaming platform with an API and a "War Room" interface on port 3333.
objects.name: T3MP3ST

objects.description: OODA pentest loop driven by the Hermes agent on a Kali container, with a web console published on port 9100.
objects.name: Vulnerator AI

objects.description: Multi-provider AI terminal under the "WormGPT" name, offered for rent by its author.
objects.name: WormXGPT

objects.description: Autonomous AI security scanner with a web console.
objects.name: Xalgorix

objects.description: Multi-agent red-team workbench with sandboxed tooling, Tor and third-party search engine lookups, console open on all interfaces by default.
objects.name: Z3r0
